definitions.explanation: A beach made up of pebbles or small stones rather than sand. Contrasts with a sand beach ({砂浜|すなはま}).

examples.japanese: {石浜|いしはま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked along a pebble beach.

examples.japanese: {石浜|いしはま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{裸足|はだし}→裸足：17169_hadashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
examples.english: A pebble beach hurts to walk on barefoot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{石浜|いしはま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ち{寄|よ}せる→打ち寄せる：28677_uchiyoseru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦からから→からから：05172_karakara⟧とした⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When waves wash up on the pebble beach, they make a distinctive rattling sound.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧ (stone) + ⟦{浜|はま}→浜：05041_hama⟧ (beach). A descriptive geographic term. May also appear as a place name or surname.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {石浜|いしはま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk on a pebble beach
- {石浜|いしはま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧: a pebble-beach coastline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{砂浜|すなはま}→砂浜：12333_sunahama⟧: sand beach — the sandy counterpart
- ⟦{磯|いそ}→磯：05389_iso⟧: rocky shore — generally larger rocks; the rocky/tidepool zone
- ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧: coast, shore — broader term
